scenes.sub: Excuse me, can you make a photo?
scenes.speaker: Elif

scenes.sub: Make one? Oh darling, I can't even draw!
scenes.speaker: Mrs. Price

more: Can you take a photo of me?

narration.why: tr#[laughs] Elif yine yaptı! Fotoğraf yapılmaz, take edilir. Doğrusu:
